fidelity_limitations: This batch improves painted detail and continuity with the published project costume. It is not a verified 1:1 reconstruction of the canonical DS1 model.

The local segmented golden mask with a continuous dark visor is a significant unresolved canonical check. The gold hood handprint, cape markings, chest pod, tubes and mustard suit are preserved project features, not newly certified official details.
Right-facing fighting and jumping gestures are fan-game adaptations. Mirroring/geometry are runtime responsibilities.
Requested outer margins were not achieved uniformly, but all full-body silhouettes, fingers, cape tips and boot soles remain inside frame. The portrait intentionally crops the lower torso.
No separate guard/crouch/rise/apex/fall rerun was produced without a concrete inspected official correction.

validation.foot_contact_method: For grounded stance/action/step/hit: alpha>96 within last ceil(0.015*bboxHeight) rows of bbox(alpha>8). Crop=bbox padded 3px and clamped to source. anchorX=midpoint of min/max support pixel extent in crop coordinates. Mean pixel center also included.
validation.foot_contact_limit: Higgs hit contact band contains the lowest rear boot only because the other boot is higher in the source. This is measured support rather than the center between both shoes.

assets.prompt: Use case: identity-preserve and style-transfer. Create ONE individual transparent raster character asset for the existing Death Stranding 2D game. The two most recent reference images show the same established Higgs DS1 fan-game costume: first a close portrait with detailed materials, then the old full-body stance. Use the FULL-BODY reference as the strict wardrobe, proportion, component-placement and silhouette guide, and the portrait as the detailed mask/hood guide. This is a faithful painted upgrade of this project costume, not a redesign. Adult male Higgs, full body oriented toward the RIGHT. Keep the black hooded cloak, gold edging, gold handprint on the side of the hood, long black cape with a blue stripe bordered by gold at its lower hem, mustard-ochre yellow practical suit, segmented antique-gold face mask with continuous dark eye visor exactly as referenced, dark neck covering, chest-mounted amber transparent pod, its harness straps, dark pouches, blue tubing, black gloves, black knee pads and heavy black boots. Keep every accessory attached to the same body side, same silhouette and color placement. PRIMARY REQUEST: neutral grounded STANCE, both boot soles planted at the same height, feet a modest distance apart and body upright, knees relaxed, one gloved hand resting near the upper cloak fastening and the other near waist. Calm controlled rightward gaze. Keep a natural adult human anatomy under the clothing. Replace the flat cel-shaded/vector-like surfaces with detailed realistic hand-painted game art: tactile woven cloak, subtle cloth weave, natural layered folds, scuffed leather, restrained gold metal reflections and worn hardware, convincing volume and soft cool directional lighting. Sharply readable silhouette but no heavy cartoon outlines, plastic toy joints, flat polygons or hard cel-shading. Full head, whole cape, every visible fingertip and both complete boot soles must be inside frame; leave 8-10 percent transparent breathing room around all outer edges. Exactly one character, one pose, no montage, no spritesheet, no grid, no duplicate. TRUE ALPHA TRANSPARENT BACKGROUND everywhere outside the figure and cape; no background scene, ground plane, floor, ground shadow, haze or opaque halo. No extra character, no umbrella, no weapon, no guitar, no DS2 red costume, no text or watermark. Preserve the existing project costume and mask rather than inventing new equipment.
